title: A Gentleman in Moscow
creator: Amor Towles
summary: A Russian count is sentenced to house arrest in a grand hotel for the rest of his life. He decides to live beautifully anyway.
personalNote: The most quietly joyful book I've read in years. It's about a man who loses everything — freedom, status, the world — and responds with elegance and curiosity. Towles writes with such warmth. I read it during a strange, stuck period of my own life and it did something useful to me.
favoriteQuote: If a man does not master his circumstances then he is bound to be mastered by them.
